0022600197.text: The Pistons (6-1) are 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East, riding a three-game win streak with a 2-0 home record, while the Lakers (6-2) are 1st in the Pacific and 4th in the West, on a two-game win streak. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both listed as out. The two teams have not met yet this season, but the Pistons won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 113-110 win in Detroit in their most recent meeting.
